pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This stage connects the validated engine-import Humanoid catalog to the editor import pipeline, persists model-owned Humanoid profiles and portable HumanoidMotion sub-assets into import metadata, exposes engine facades for the new animation/import modules, and preserves explicitly authored profile mappings across reimport so stale mappings fail visibly instead of being silently replaced by automatic detection.
